outline:
本門授課之目的在介紹各種有機化合物之合成方法、原理及應用，並探討有機實驗室常用之有機反應及其反應機構。
The course introduces various kinds of organic synthetic methods, principles and applications.  The most commonly used organic reactions and their mechanisms are also discussed.
schedule:
1-3週: Conjugated Pi Systems and Pericyclic Reactions
4-5週: Aromatic Compounds
6-7週: Aromatic Substitution Reactions
8週: 期中考
9-10週: Aldehydes and Ketones
11-13週: Carboxylic Acids and Their Derivatives
14-15週: Alpha Carbon Chemistry: Enols and Enolates
16週: 期末考
17週: 彈性學習
18週: 彈性學習

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content: 講解有機合成上較廣泛應用之方法，如過渡金屬催化有機反應等。
flexible_learning.outcome: 第17、18週之學習對學生將來進入實驗室進行研究有很大的幫助

assessment:
出缺席: 30%
期中考: 30%
期末考: 30%
彈性學習: 10%
